name: New Horizons recording
description: A clean copy of the core signal, caught by your ship's long-range array more clearly than any receiver in Sol.

name: Ninefold flight recorder
description: The last logs of a consortium survey tender lost at Wolf 359. Your drive core hums when it plays.

name: Celeste's decode
description: The Oort signal, rendered as a picture: a ring of stars, one going dark, and a hand raised to a mouth.

name: Aurum Meridian's broadcast plan
description: Noori's stolen files: Aurum intends to answer the core from Sirius, as loudly as it can.

name: The Hush star map
description: A map the beacon gave you, reaching far past Vega. Dozens of stars are marked. Most of them have gone quiet.

name: Ninefold survey charts
description: Hand-plotted charts of the outer Oort Cloud. One point far past Pluto is circled three times: FOUND IT HERE.

name: Hadley's notebook
description: A Tallis Camp miner's notes: frequencies, star names, a ring of dots with one filled in black, and a hand raised to a mouth, scribbled out.

name: Consortium build sheet
description: The Lalande consortium's assembly notes for your ship. Handwritten in the margin: "Do not power the core before hull seal. Do not let it hear the Oort."

name: Darkside night recording
description: Forty miners asleep on their feet on the ice, all facing the same way, all whispering the same word.

name: Europa sample vial
description: Water from under Europa's ice. Most of the time it's dark. Near your drive core, it glows: seven pulses, a rest, eleven.

name: Rubbing from the Vega bulkhead
description: Charcoal on paper: your ship's hull number, scratched into the waystation at Vega forty-one years before she was built.

name: Juno's nav core
description: A racing nav core with a crude sticker of a comet on it. Kade Marlow was very reluctant to part with it.

name: Terminator Run pennant
description: Juno's winner's pennant from the Terminator Run. She signed it with a lipstick kiss and the words "for my pit crew."

name: Dez's sealed crate
description: Heavy, cold, and sealed with three kinds of tape. If you put your ear to it, it whispers.

name: Vesna's letter
description: A sealed letter for Mira Ilyin, Verdance. The handwriting on the envelope is very careful.

name: Mira's reply
description: A letter back to Vesna, and a small paper bag of honey bread that smells like home.

name: Vesna's Academy wings
description: A pilot's wings from the Tranquility Academy, the pin worn smooth. She said she didn't need them anymore. She said it like it cost her.
